div.h3: Inside one eval run: phases, not a per-question loop

div.p: Why phases. Per question the loop needed the embedder, then the reranker, then the generator. Together they do not fit in 8 GB, so ollama evicted and reloaded a model on every single question. Phases make each stage own the card alone: two swaps per run instead of two per question, and the reranker gets a real batch (44 s for 100 questions on the card, about 16 min on CPU).
Interactive answers stay a straight line: one question cannot be batched, and the agent decides for itself when to search.

g.text: one embeddings batch for the whole set (bge-m3)
hybrid search per question, wide pool when reranking
flatten to pairs: 100 questions x 20 candidates = 2000
one predict for all of them, fp16 on the card
slice scores back per question, keep top k
answer from the context that is already prepared (llama3.1:8b)
question_log + config snapshot: rerank, device, k, phased
